items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump (timing cover removal), flush oil and coolant
items.note: If coolant has already damaged the bearings, an engine replacement runs $4,000–$7,000 or more.

items.t: Engine failure after coolant contamination or oil starvation
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured long block
items.note: Owners report an average of about $5,000 on CarComplaints.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit (PTU) leaks or fails
items.job: Replace PTU seals and fluid (whole unit if gears are damaged)
items.note: Seals and fluid are on the low end; a new or rebuilt PTU is on the high end.

items.job: Replace wheel hub and bearing assembly (one corner)
items.note: Rusted-in hubs can add labor time.

items.t: Rear side window shatters on its own
items.note: Check your comprehensive insurance; glass claims often have a low deductible.
